hero.lead: Give your AI agent a real GMX inbox in minutes. Read, search, send, reply, schedule and organize mail with IMAP and your account password, and use the same inbox in every MCP client, not just one.
hero.meta1: Your account password, no OAuth setup
hero.answer: Claude cannot reach GMX on its own. MCP Emails is a hosted MCP server that connects it over IMAP using your account password, so Claude, Cursor or any MCP client can read, search, send and organize that mail. Setup takes a couple of minutes and one inbox is free.

method.title: How GMX connects: IMAP and your account password
method.body: GMX connects over IMAP/SMTP, but POP3 and IMAP access is switched off by default. On a German GMX account, turn it on under E-Mail-Einstellungen (email settings), E-Mail empfangen, POP3/IMAP; on gmx.com it is the Email tab, Settings, POP3 & IMAP. Then connect with your GMX address and password, or with an App-Passwort if two-factor authentication is on. German accounts use the .net hosts, imap.gmx.net and mail.gmx.net. GMX's international help lists imap.gmx.com and mail.gmx.com for gmx.com.

setup.p: Sign up for MCP Emails, no card required. The free plan connects one inbox, forever.

setup.h: Turn on IMAP access in GMX
setup.p: Sign in to GMX in a browser, click the circle with your initials, open E-Mail-Einstellungen, choose POP3/IMAP under E-Mail empfangen and move the slider to POP3- und IMAP-Zugriff erlauben (allow POP3 and IMAP access). On gmx.com: the Email tab, then Settings, then POP3 & IMAP.

setup.h: Add the mailbox in MCP Emails
setup.p: Choose IMAP / SMTP, add your GMX address, the hosts above and the password to connect the inbox securely.

setup.h: Paste the MCP URL into your AI
setup.p: Drop https://mcpemails.com/api/mcp into Claude, Cursor or ChatGPT, authorize, and your agent has the inbox.

gotchas.h: GMX switches POP3 and IMAP off by default, and switches them off again later
gotchas.p: External access to a GMX mailbox is deactivated until you enable it. On a German account, sign in at gmx.net, click the circle with your initials in the top bar, open E-Mail-Einstellungen, choose POP3/IMAP under E-Mail empfangen, move the slider under POP3-/IMAP-Abruf to POP3- und IMAP-Zugriff erlauben, and solve the small puzzle GMX shows, where you drag two symbols on top of each other. On gmx.com the same switch is the Email tab, Settings, POP3 & IMAP, Enable access to this account via POP3 and IMAP. GMX also documents that it turns the permission off again automatically, for security, when the mailbox goes a long time without POP3 or IMAP use. So a connection that worked for months can stop with a login failure while nothing changed on your side.

gotchas.h: Outgoing mail goes to mail.gmx.net, on port 587 or 465
gotchas.p: GMX names its outgoing server mail.gmx.net, where most providers use an smtp prefix. GMX's help lists port 587 with STARTTLS, port 465 with SSL as the alternative, and TLS 1.2 or 1.3 only: older TLS versions and SMTP after POP are no longer supported. smtp.gmx.net also exists, as an alias that points at the same server and is covered by its certificate, so either name works. MCP Emails fills in mail.gmx.net, the name GMX documents, on port 465.

gotchas.h: GMX will accept a 135 MB message that the recipient will then refuse
gotchas.p: GMX Mail's submission server announces a maximum message size of roughly 135 MB, which is by a wide margin the largest of any provider on this site. That is a ceiling on what GMX will take from you, not a promise of delivery. The receiving server applies its own limit, and most sit somewhere between 10 MB and 50 MB, so a large attachment that GMX cheerfully accepts can still bounce minutes later from the other end. If an agent is sending something big, share a link instead.

gotchas.h: With two-factor authentication on, mail programs need an App-Passwort
gotchas.p: GMX files its app password under two-factor authentication and describes it as the password for external mail programs over POP3 and IMAP. Create it in a browser: click your initials, then Account verwalten, then Login & Sicherheit, then App-Passwörter (für externe Apps), then Neues App-Passwort erstellen. Give it a name such as MCP Emails and copy it straight away, because GMX shows it only once. If you lose it, delete it and create a new one. GMX's IMAP offers only the PLAIN and LOGIN mechanisms, with no OAuth path, so the credential is always a password of one kind or the other.

gotchas.h: A mail program cannot tell you why GMX refused it, but the browser can
gotchas.p: A refused IMAP login carries no reason, so POP3/IMAP access switched off, a missing App-Passwort and a mistyped password all look the same from outside. GMX's own advice when a mail program fails to connect is to sign in to GMX directly in a browser on a computer and read the message shown there. Do that before you change anything else: it tells the three causes apart in one step.

limits: GMX can deactivate POP3 and IMAP again after a long period without protocol activity, which disconnects the mailbox until you switch it back on in the web interface.
There is no OAuth option for GMX Mail, so the credential stored is a password. Changing your GMX password disconnects the mailbox until you enter the new one.

faq.q: Does Claude work with GMX Mail?
faq.a: Not on its own. Claude has no built-in GMX connector. Connecting an MCP server such as MCP Emails to your GMX mailbox over IMAP gives Claude read, search, send, reply, schedule and organize access to it, and the same connection works from Cursor, ChatGPT and other MCP clients. You have to enable POP3 and IMAP access in GMX first.

faq.q: What are the GMX Mail IMAP and SMTP settings?
faq.a: For a German GMX account, IMAP is imap.gmx.net on port 993 with SSL. Outgoing mail is mail.gmx.net, on port 587 with STARTTLS or port 465 with SSL; MCP Emails uses 465. smtp.gmx.net is an alias for the same outgoing server. The username is your full GMX address. GMX's international help lists imap.gmx.com and mail.gmx.com for gmx.com accounts.

faq.q: How do I enable IMAP in GMX?
faq.a: Sign in to GMX in a web browser, click your initials, open E-Mail-Einstellungen, choose POP3/IMAP under E-Mail empfangen and move the slider to POP3- und IMAP-Zugriff erlauben, then solve the drag puzzle GMX shows. On gmx.com it is the Email tab, Settings, POP3 & IMAP. Until this is on, GMX refuses every mail-client login and the error looks exactly like a wrong password.

faq.q: Why did my GMX connection stop working on its own?
faq.a: GMX documents that it deactivates POP3 and IMAP access automatically, for security reasons, when a mailbox goes a long time without using those protocols. Nothing on your side has to change for this to happen. Sign in through a browser, switch POP3/IMAP access back on in the settings, and the connection works again with the same password.

faq.q: Does GMX need an app password?
faq.a: Only with two-factor authentication on. Then create an App-Passwort in a browser under Account verwalten, Login & Sicherheit, App-Passwörter (für externe Apps), and use it in MCP Emails instead of your GMX password. GMX shows it only once; if you lose it, delete it and create a new one.

faq.q: Is my GMX mail stored on your servers?
faq.a: No. Messages are fetched live from GMX over IMAP for each request and handed to your AI client. Credentials are encrypted at rest and message bodies are not retained. Turning POP3 and IMAP access back off in GMX cuts the connection at their end immediately.
